fusions.name: Smoked-Out Workers
fusions.desc: Lifts your scales and looses 3 stingers, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage, with a 35% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lapped Clean
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. Your tongue lashes the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Guarded Comb
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 20 damage for 6 seconds. A guard swarm fights beside you for 8 seconds, stinging for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked Nest
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a stinger from under your scales strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
